newsitem.title: USA: China buys 7,000 T Brazil soyoil- U.S. exporters.
newsitem.headline: China buys 7,000 T Brazil soyoil- U.S. exporters.

text.p: A commercial firm purchased 7,000 tonnes of Brazilian soyoil Wednesday for shipment to China, U.S. exporters said.
The purchase was made at $540.00 per tonne FOB for May delivery by a firm that is typically associated with China, exporters said.
Chicago Board of Trade soy markets rallied Wednesday in response to ongoing talk that China has been an active buyer of soybeans in the U.S. and South America.
Soyoil futures ended up 0.13 to 0.27 cent per lb, with July up 0.21 at 25.47 cents. Soybeans ended 5-3/4 to 22 cents per bushel higher, with July up 21-1/4 at $8.87.
